mapper.select: SELECT TRMS_SN, TRMS_TYPE_CD, VER_NO, TRMS_TTL, ESNTL_YN FROM (SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TRMS_TYPE_CD ORDER BY ENFC_DT DESC, VER_NO DESC, TRMS_SN DESC) rn FROM TRMS_MST t WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND ENFC_DT <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) x WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY TRMS_TYPE_CD, VER_NO
SELECT TRMS_SN, TRMS_TYPE_CD, VER_NO, TRMS_TTL, ESNTL_YN, TRMS_CN FROM TRMS_MST WHERE TRMS_SN = #{trmsSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND ENFC_DT <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
